name: ethereum-faucet
description: Modern Ethereum faucet stack (smart contract + API + frontend)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w contracts
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w apps/api && npm run lint -w apps/web && npm run lint -w contracts
